get_model_family_name: get the model family name from a fairseq2 asset card by name or AssetCard object
maybe_get_model_family_name: safely get the model family name from an asset card returning None if no model definition exists
StandardModelFamily_load_model: load a model from an asset card with distributed gang support and optional memory-mapped checkpoint loading
StandardModelFamily_create_new_model: create a new model instance from a config with optional meta device initialization across distributed gangs
StandardModelFamily_iter_checkpoint: iterate over checkpoint state dict tensors from a model checkpoint file with sharding and mmap support
